proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console label showing CUH model number and serial (sticker).
Video of the console powering on and showing the home screen/library with the installed games list.
Video test: HDMI to TV works + at least one USB port works (controller charging/recognition).
Video showing gameplay for 20–30 minutes (or a stress test) to confirm no overheating/shutdown.
Photo of the UK receipt and photos of all included accessories/cables (power lead, HDMI, etc.).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only a text assertion. Without new photos/videos, the key value drivers (exact PS4 model, installed games, port functionality, overheating/health, and receipt/accessories) remain unverified remotely, so pricing would be guesswork.
